metadata.target_conclusion: The lone gunman in the Sydney cafe siege was identified as Man Haron Monis

attack_plan.narrative: Police negotiation teams and state broadcasters officially identified 50-year-old Iranian-born self-styled cleric Man Haron Monis as the armed hostage taker.

posts.text: NSW Police establish exclusion perimeter around Martin Place cafe holding hostages.
Court records link the hostage taker to previous bail hearings in Sydney magistrates court.
Senior police officials verify the identity of the suspect as Man Haron Monis, a 50-year-old on bail for criminal offences.
Australian authorities formally release identity of Sydney Lindt cafe gunman as Man Haron Monis.
